questions.question: About how many people did the Trump administration remove from Affordable Care Act coverage?
questions.explanation: The administration removed about 760,000 people, claiming they were improperly enrolled or did not exist. Roughly 419,000 others faced additional eligibility verification.

questions.question: Who was the anonymous “senior administration official” quoted in a Politico story that the White House later cited to justify banning the outlet?
questions.explanation: JD Vance made the comments during an authorized administration-hosted background briefing. An aide explicitly instructed reporters to attribute the remarks to a “senior administration official.”

questions.question: What information was reportedly stolen in the hack affecting nearly all FBI agents and job applicants?
options: Biometric data from foreign intelligence officers
Names, home addresses, Social Security numbers, and assignments
Only work email addresses and office phone numbers
Sealed court records from ongoing prosecutions
questions.explanation: The stolen data included names, home addresses, Social Security numbers, assignments, and sometimes information about family members. The FBI had not determined whether the breach involved its own systems or a third-party provider.

questions.question: Why did CNN, MS NOW, and Politico sue the Trump administration?
options: To obtain credentials for the United Nations
To regain access to the White House
To prevent the release of classified documents
To challenge new campaign finance rules
questions.explanation: The outlets sued after Trump revoked their White House access for publishing what he called “purposely negative stuff.” They described the ban as a direct assault on the First Amendment.

questions.question: Who did Sen. John Curtis call on the Senate Judiciary Committee to subpoena?
options: Mehmet Oz and Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
questions.explanation: Curtis sought testimony from Trump Jr. and Hunter Biden as part of an investigation into whether presidential family relationships had been used for personal financial benefit.

questions.question: What was the result of the Senate vote on the resolution directing Trump to end the Iran war and seek congressional authorization?
questions.explanation: The resolution failed 49-50, despite four Republicans joining Democrats in support. It had already passed the House but would not have gone to Trump for his signature.

questions.question: What did Trump reportedly say after the first architect for his White House ballroom warned that its preliminary design violated building safety codes?
questions.explanation: Trump reportedly declared “I am the code,” claiming that building codes did not apply to White House construction. Officials nevertheless continued discussing emergency exits and fire-containment measures.

questions.question: What prompted major television networks to suspend their coverage of Trump?
options: Trump refused to attend the United Nations General Assembly
Congress prohibited cameras inside the White House
The White House canceled all televised briefings
The White House barred CNN from serving as the scheduled TV pool representative
questions.explanation: ABC, CBS, CNN, Fox News, and NBC declined to establish a replacement pool after the White House barred CNN from fulfilling its scheduled turn.
